notes: dc CALL 2026-10-28 (Q1 FY2027, fiscal Q1 ends 2026-09-30). Alpha Vantage 2027Q1 returned an empty transcript (checked once); AV 2026Q4 = the July call. Q1 call figures come from a WebFetch summary of the Fool transcript page (secondary, search_excerpt), cross-checked to the release and 10-Q where possible; quote-level wording not verified.

dc MGMT (call, secondary) demand continues to exceed available supply; third-party GPU capacity deliveries slipped from Q1/Q2 into H2 FY27; capex to be above 50B in Q2 and rise in H2; calendar-year capex of about 170B stated by CNBC for calendar 2027 while other outlets say 2026: period UNVERIFIED, not entered as guidance. Company says it stays free cash flow positive in FY27 and may tap outside financing; Q1 free cash flow 18.6B (58.0B OCF less 39.4B cash capex per statements).

dc MGMT (release) segment structure changed in September 2026: Agents and Infra (apps/agents, multi-model system, Azure) and Devices and Consumer; prior periods recast for Q1 only in the 10-Q; FY2026 segment lines above are the old three-segment 10-K structure, not comparable.

dc MGMT (release) Q1 FY27 results exceeded expectations across revenue, operating income and EPS; Microsoft Cloud growth accelerated to 30%. Windows OEM revenue -27% on call (OEM only; release says OEM and Devices -22%) on weak PC demand and partner inventory drawdown.

dc FACT OpenAI: 10.0B of Q1 revenue (10.8%) from OpenAI arrangements incl. revenue share, 7.2B receivable, 24% as-converted stake, 13.0B total funding commitment of which 12.0B funded; Q1 OpenAI net gain 272M pretax / 207M after tax (non-GAAP excludes it; prior-year quarter was a 3.1B after-tax loss). OpenAI share of RPO not disclosed in the documents read.

dc FACT Commercial RPO 677B (+73% y/y; 678B in Q4 FY26, +84%): sequential change about -1B; weighted duration 2.3 years; about 30% recognized in the next 12 months, i.e. about 203B. RPO concentration by customer not disclosed.

dc FACT Lease and purchase obligations (10-K FY26 table): total 743.8B of which leases incl. imputed interest 443.5B, purchase commitments 194.1B (169.0B within 1 year; mostly datacenter, take-or-pay), construction 34.6B; datacenter leases not yet commenced 364.6B at 2026-09-30 (329.1B at 2026-06-30), commencing FY27-FY34. Debt at 2026-09-30: 35.5B (4.4B current); repaid 4.85B in Q1.

dc FACT Q1 FY27 cash capex 39.4B (up 103% y/y from 19.4B), D&A and other 11.7B (up 44%); about three quarters of capex on short-lived assets (CPUs/GPUs) per call; Q4 FY26 two thirds. Gross margin 67.8% (62,559/92,279) vs 69.0% prior year; operating margin 49.8% vs 48.9%.
dc FACT Share count: 7,427M outstanding, diluted weighted average 7,446M (7,466M a year ago); Q1 buybacks 4.4B and dividends 6.8B; 40.6B left of the 60B program at 2026-06-30.
dc RISK 1 (10-K Item 1A, competition) intense competition across all markets (cloud, AI, productivity, gaming, search) can cut volumes and prices.

dc RISK 2 (10-K Item 1A, cloud and AI strategy) demand for AI services is hard to forecast; overestimating demand or misaligned capacity investment, and uncertain AI cost structure, could hit returns; heavy reliance on third-party model partners (OpenAI).

dc RISK 3 (10-K Item 1A, infrastructure) datacenter expansion limited by electrical power, land, permitting, skilled labor and scarce suppliers of critical components (memory/GPU/CPU pricing, shortages); outages or capacity constraints.

dc RISK 4 (10-K Item 1A, investments) significant investments that may not achieve expected returns; capex 39-45B a quarter and 364.6B of leases not yet commenced create a fixed cost base if demand disappoints.
dc RISK 5 (10-K Item 1A, security and AI) cyberattacks, security vulnerabilities and AI misuse/quality issues could cause liability, reputational harm and lost revenue.
dc RISK 6 (10-K Item 1A, legal and regulatory) evolving AI, privacy, competition and antitrust regulation, litigation, government-contract uncertainty and tax audits (large foreign earnings share).
dc RISK 7 (10-K Item 1A, macro and distribution) adverse economic conditions; OEM/partner channel dependence (Windows OEM currently -22%); geopolitical and catastrophic events.

dc RISK 8 (counterparty, from 10-Q related-party note) OpenAI is both 10.8% of revenue, a 24% equity-method investee and a large share of backlog drivers: concentration and funding risk at one counterparty.
